method: Hand-written blind probes. Sources read: docs/ops/INDEX.en.md, a directory walk of docs/ops/<family>/<category>/ listing op note filenames (all categories for 52 families; for the 4 large families 2d/3d/optics/drive only a few categories: 2d measure1d/subpix/contour/texture, 3d robust_fit/match_pose/terrain, optics lensmerit/polarization/telecentric, drive ttc/lateral/agv), and one op note (fit/fit_circle_geometric.md) for format. No recipebook, recipes.py, RECIPE_INDEX.json or gen_recipe* was opened. Each query states a plausible factory/research task in plain words; ops are the author's judgement of core operators, chosen from op names (most notes not opened), so expected op sets are plausible-not-unique. Language alternates en/ja by position (30/30). Every op verified to exist as docs/ops/<family>/*/<op>.md by script.
